attempts.summary: Built a fresh three-member etcd 2.2.5 cluster (Ubuntu 16.04 i386, apt package) across node1/node2/node3 holding application keys, then simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped its data dir) while quorum on node1+node2 kept serving reads/writes. Removed the dead member via etcdctl, added a new member for node3, reconfigured it with ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing, and started it - it joined and caught up via the raft log, restoring three healthy members with all original application keys intact. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: rebooted node1, node2, then node3 one at a time, confirming boot_id changes and full etcd/cluster-membership recovery with data intact after each.
